LSJ,

When a minion strikes for, say -2 strength, does that minion's strike
resolve for 0 damage or -2 damage?

(*And yes, I have something brewing based on your answer*)

-Mike Ooi

Messages.Author: Sorrow
Messages.Body:
> When a minion strikes for, say -2 strength, does that minion's strike
> resolve for 0 damage or -2 damage?
> (*And yes, I have something brewing based on your answer*)

My guess is that it resolves for -2 but the minion takes no damage. So if
the striking minion were to try to actually inflict damage, it would have to
generate an additional +3 (to resolve to 1 damage).
This would fall in line with negative bleeds and bleed modifiers/Life Boon.

Sorrow

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Sorrow wrote:
>
> > When a minion strikes for, say -2 strength, does that minion's strike
> > resolve for 0 damage or -2 damage?
> > (*And yes, I have something brewing based on your answer*)
>
> My guess is that it resolves for -2 but the minion takes no damage. So if
> the striking minion were to try to actually inflict damage, it would have to
> generate an additional +3 (to resolve to 1 damage).
> This would fall in line with negative bleeds and bleed modifiers/Life Boon.

Mostly correct. It resolves for -2, resulting in 0 damage "successfully inflicted".
So if you do just 0 (more than -2) damage - you still get only 0 damage "successfully
inflicted" - not more than your opponent - no Disarm.
